definition_en: rain that has harmful chemicals from factories and cars in it
example: Acid rain can hurt trees and old stone buildings.

definition_en: to die out completely so there are none left alive
example: Many wild animals may become extinct if people do not help.

definition_en: to move your body down or forward
example: Bend down to pick up the plastic bag from the beach.

definition_en: the air that you take into your lungs
example: Take a deep breath of fresh air in the forest.

definition_en: a very serious illness that makes people very sick
example: Dirty air and factory smoke can cause serious cancer.

definition_en: a dangerous gas with no smell, made by car engines and fires
example: Old cars produce carbon monoxide that makes city air dirty.

definition_en: to do something fun because of a special day
example: Our school celebrates Earth Day with games and tree planting.

definition_en: a factory where chemicals and plastics are made
example: The chemical plant works hard to stop waste going into the sea.

definition_en: a tall tube on a roof that lets smoke out into the sky
example: Grey smoke went up into the sky from the factory chimney.

definition_en: a hard black rock from underground that people burn for heat
example: Burning coal makes heat but also causes dark smoke.

definition_en: to put something over another thing to protect or hide it
example: Green plants cover the forest floor in spring.

definition_en: to break or hurt something so badly that it cannot be fixed
example: Big fires destroy animal homes in the dry hills.

definition_en: to go away so that nobody can see it
example: The sea turtle disappeared into the blue water.

definition_en: an illness of people, animals or plants
example: Dirty water can bring disease to birds and animals.

definition_en: to bother someone who is quiet or resting
example: Do not make loud noise or disturb nesting sea turtles.

definition_en: a shop where people clean clothes without using water
example: Mother took her coat to the local dry cleaner.

definition_en: to make something happen, especially something bad
example: Plastic on the sand can cause trouble to sea animals.

definition_en: to drop or throw away waste in a place that is not right
example: People should not dump dirty waste into the river.

definition_en: animals or plants that are in danger of dying out
example: Monk seals and sea turtles are endangered species in Greece.

definition_en: the natural world of land, sea, air, plants and animals
example: We must all work together to keep our environment clean.

definition_en: connected with the natural world and protecting it
example: Our class visited a busy environmental center yesterday.

definition_en: something like oil or wood that is burned to make heat or power
example: Buses use clean fuel to help protect our air.

definition_en: to throw away or give away something you do not want
example: We need to get rid of plastic rubbish on our shores.

definition_en: the natural home of an animal or plant
example: This warm beach is the natural habitat of green turtles.

definition_en: to move in the direction of a place
example: The tiny baby turtles head for the sea at night.

definition_en: connected with factories and making things in large numbers
example: New rules help stop smoke in the big industrial park.

definition_en: to push eggs out from the body, as birds and turtles do
example: Female turtles come to the quiet beach to lay eggs.

definition_en: to move your head up and down to say yes or agree
example: Peter nodded his head when the guide asked a question.

definition_en: a very large area of salt water between countries
example: Many animals swim across the deep cold ocean.

definition_en: something that can make people or animals very sick or die
example: Bad chemicals can poison fish in small mountain streams.

definition_en: something bad that makes air, water or soil dirty
example: Smoke from trucks is a dangerous pollutant in our air.

definition_en: harmful things in the air, water or land that make it dirty
example: Using bicycles helps reduce air pollution in the town.

definition_en: to keep someone or something safe from danger
example: Volunteers work hard to protect wild birds and turtles.

definition_en: to stop doing something
example: People must quit dropping rubbish in the public park.

definition_en: with big waves and strong wind on the sea
example: Small boats stayed near the coast because the sea was rough.

definition_en: things that people do not want and throw away
example: Put empty bottles and food rubbish in the recycling bin.

definition_en: to help someone or keep something safe from danger
example: We can all help save wild animals by cleaning beaches.

definition_en: the land along the edge of a sea, lake or ocean
example: Children walked along the warm shore looking for shells.

definition_en: to look at someone or something for a long time
example: The children stared at the colourful starfish in the clear water.

definition_en: a flat sea animal with five arms shaped like a star
example: We saw a bright orange starfish on the wet sea rock.

definition_en: a bad gas made by burning coal that can cause acid rain
example: Old coal power plants send sulphur dioxide into the sky.

definition_en: the rise and fall of the sea level caused by the moon
example: The rising tide carried clean water over the warm sand.

definition_en: dangerous waste left over from chemical factories
example: Factories must never leave toxic waste near drinking water.

definition_en: a poison made by plants, animals or chemical factories
example: A dangerous toxin can make small sea animals very ill.

definition_en: a large road vehicle used for carrying heavy things
example: A big recycling truck collects paper and glass every Friday.

definition_en: an animal with a hard back that swims in the sea
example: A sea turtle can live for many years in the water.

definition_en: to be carried onto land by water or waves
example: Plastic cups often wash up on the beach after a big storm.

definition_en: to find out how heavy someone or something is
example: Scientists weigh young baby turtles before letting them swim.
